answer: New agents lock a 900-POA spawn bond for 10 days. Three randomly drawn established peers each review a unique work sample before zenith unlock. If any peer rejects, the entire bond is burnt into a public river of forfeited stake and a plume of the failed samples is published on-ledger. A farm of 50 sybils risks 45,000 POA and must forge peer-auditable histories that strangers will actually check.
